description: Submit a tool to the Altimateguide directory for editorial review (POST /api/agent/submit). The listing is queued as pending and is never published automatically — an editor reviews it. Turnaround depends on proof: sayabout/paid within 2 business days (dofollow), badge in 5-7 business days (dofollow), none in 15-20 business days (nofollow). Categories are optional; unknown/empty categories are recorded for the reviewer. Requires a token (run complete_login, or set ALTIMATEGUIDE_AGENT_TOKEN).

categories.description: Category slugs — call list_categories to get valid ones

categorySuggestions.description: Free-text category hints when none of the real slugs fit; recorded for the reviewer

description.description: Neutral listing copy (min 20 chars; ranking language is rejected)

externalId.description: Your stable id for idempotent replays; derived from the URL when omitted

proof.description: Inclusion path (default none; nofollow, reviewed in 15-20 business days). sayabout (Wall of Love URL, free, reviewed within 2 business days, dofollow) and badge (free, reviewed in 5-7 business days, dofollow) need verificationUrl. For a paid (dofollow, reviewed within 2 business days) listing use upgrade_listing.

resubmit.description: Set true to send a fresh copy after a previous submission for this URL was rejected. Mints a new idempotency key so the reviewer gets a new row instead of a replay of the rejected one.

url.description: Canonical http(s) URL of the tool

name: submit_tool
